finalPrompts.name: nightflight-logo-starboat-clean
finalPrompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: repair of existing 银河夜航 星舟 logo, not a new concept.
Input image: Image 1 is the exact logo edit target.
Primary request: repair the provided starboat logo. Preserve the original layout, scale, position and recognizable identity: one silver-white four-point navigation star above, a simple silver-white boat formed by curved tapered shapes below, and the tilted cool-blue open galactic orbital arc around the boat. Keep these same elements and proportions. Remove every stray white speck, fragment, pixel scatter, cyan fringe, leftover outline, scratch, ragged edge and partial cutout residue. Rebuild the fills as complete clean solid shapes with smooth crisp antialiased contours. All intentional negative spaces should be empty and clean. Use flat silver-white and cool blue fills without shading or glow.
Background: replace all transparent pixels and all background with one fully opaque uniform solid deep indigo-black #040811 (RGB 4,8,17), including every space between logo shapes. No transparency anywhere. No texture, noise or vignette.
Constraints: keep the same starboat concept and composition, square image, no crop, no added objects, no words, no Chinese characters, no mockup, no watermark, no gradients, no stars outside the one existing navigation star. This is one targeted cleaning pass.

initialPrompts.name: nightflight-hero
initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide website hero background for 银河夜航 (do not render the name)
Primary request: a tranquil, profound night sky with authentic photographic texture. Nearly black deep indigo space, a very faint silver-blue Milky Way with real dark dust lanes and many fine individual stars, just a few warm stars. The Milky Way gently angles from the upper right toward the lower right-of-center. It must remain subtle and never become a bright white smoke cloud.
Composition/framing: ultra-wide landscape, 16:9 or wider, preferably 2048×1152. Keep the entire left half very dark with generous negative space suitable for a large Chinese headline, with only sparse dim stars. The richer star field and faint galactic structure stay to the right. No horizon is needed.
Lighting/mood: quiet, restrained, expansive, premium fine-art astrophotography.
Constraints: an artistic website photograph, not scientific simulation data. No text, no logos, no interface, no spacecraft, no planet globes, no exaggerated lens flares, no huge bright nebulae.

initialPrompts.name: nightflight-logo-starboat
initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone square logo symbol candidate for 银河夜航, concept 星舟, no text
Primary request: create one minimal, professionally designed graphic symbol. A clean gently rising galactic arc subtly suggests a small boat, and a single navigation star above suggests direction. Build a cohesive compact mark using very few clear geometric shapes. It should remain recognizable when reduced to a small website logo.
Style/medium: flat vector-like graphic with crisp edges, silver-white and cool blue only, refined balance, no dimensional rendering or effects.
Composition/framing: a single centered symbol on a square canvas, approximately 1024×1024, with a modest transparent margin.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha channel; no solid-colored background and no simulated transparency checkerboard.
Constraints: no letters, no words, no Chinese text, no watermark, no badge, no brand mockup, no starfield, no detailed illustration, no gradients, no shadow, no glow.
